description: Core conversational and self-improvement contracts. Compiled UTC/fixed-offset time/date and bounded finite arithmetic are implemented; current-session reads, current-agent prompt reads and bounded bundled skill reads are implemented. Other session, progress and configuration operations still require independent v3 implementations.
migration_note: Partial V3 port: get_time, get_date, calculate, read_attachment, search_this_session, list_skills, load_skill and read_own_prompt use compiled Rust adapters. Bundled skill loading never activates abilities or grants execution. Other declared Base tools remain unavailable. Each new ability still requires explicit installation, account-tier and membership grants; manifest metadata alone never registers a tool.
